\section{Overview}

Declarations of the Lean module \texttt{TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Logspace.ISCountGenRadius}.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{definition}[Initial-code membership]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.InitM}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.InitM}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.initLang, Turing.FinNDTM, Turing.pairEncode}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$
be a finite Boolean string, and let $s,u\in\mathbb{N}$. The pair encoding of $x$ with
the pair encoding of the binary expansions of $u$ and $s$ belongs to the initial
language of $N$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Accepting-code membership]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.AccM}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.AccM}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.acceptLang, Turing.FinNDTM, Turing.pairEncode}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$
be a finite Boolean string, and let $s,u\in\mathbb{N}$. The pair encoding of $x$ with
the pair encoding of the binary expansions of $u$ and $s$ belongs to the accepting
language of $N$.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Bounded membership and coded reachability]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.mem_ball_iff_rcode}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.mem_ball_iff_rcode}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.StepRel, Complexity.Codec.cfgCode, Complexity.Codec.cfgCode_lt, Complexity.Codec.codeK, Complexity.Codec.mem_initLang, Complexity.ExpBFS.RCode, Complexity.ExpBFS.rcode_lt, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.ball, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.mem_ball, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.InitM, Complexity.exists_walkLe, Complexity.logSpace, Complexity.walkLe_reach, Complexity.walkLe_short, Turing.NDTM.initCfg}
\difficulty{5}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a
finite Boolean string, and let $s,K$ be natural numbers satisfying
$2^{\mathrm{codeK}(N)(s+\mathrm{logSpace}(|x|)+1)}\le K$. For every natural number $t$,
$t$ belongs to the set of numbers below $K$ that satisfy the initial-code condition and
are connected to $t$ by a walk of at most $K$ steps of the encoded transition relation
if and only if $t$ is reachable from the code of $N$’s initial configuration on $x$ by a
finite sequence of encoded transitions at space bound $s$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Reachable-set and ball cardinalities]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.card_ball_eq_rset}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.card_ball_eq_rset}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.StepRel, Complexity.Codec.codeK, Complexity.ExpBFS.card_filter_rcode, Complexity.ExpBFS.rcode_lt, Complexity.ExpBFS.rset, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.ball, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.InitM, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.mem_ball_iff_rcode, Complexity.logSpace}
\difficulty{3}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$
be a finite bit string, and let $s,K$ be natural numbers. If $2^{\text{code
length}\times(s+\text{logarithmic space of }|x|+1)}\langle K$, where the code length is the
machine's configuration-code bound, then the set of numbers in the $K$-bounded ball at
level $K$, formed using the step relation at window radius $s$ and the corresponding
initial-code predicate, has the same cardinality as the finite set of codes reachable
from the initial configuration code within the stated code bound.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Ball cardinality at zero code]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.card_ball_zero_code}

\leanok

\difficulty{2}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$

\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Nonempty set of reachable configuration codes]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.one_le_card_rset}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.one_le_card_rset}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.ExpBFS.mem_rset, Complexity.ExpBFS.rset}
\difficulty{1}
Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with a finite state set $Q$, $k$ work
tapes, and a read-only input tape, and let $x$ be a finite bit string and $s$ a natural
number. Consider the natural numbers less than $2^{(2(3(|Q|+1)+3k+1)+2)(s+\lfloor\log_2
|x|\rfloor+2)}$ that are reachable from the code of the initial configuration of $N$ on
input $x$ by zero or more steps, where each step is a valid machine transition and both
configurations lie within the work-tape window of radius $s$. This set has cardinality
at least one.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Reachability and bounded balls]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.noAcc_balls_iff}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.noAcc_balls_iff}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.StepRel, Complexity.Codec.codeK, Complexity.ExpBFS.RCode, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.ball, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.ball_mono, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.AccM, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.InitM, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.mem_ball_iff_rcode, Complexity.logSpace}
\difficulty{4}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input, let $x$ be a
finite Boolean word, and let $s,K\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $2^{(2W+2)(s+\lfloor\log_2
|x|\rfloor+2)}\le K$, where $W$ is the encoding chunk width of $N$. The following are
equivalent: for every $j$ with $0<j\le K$, every code in the ball of radius $j$ formed
from initial codes below $K$ using the one-step relation is not accepting; and every
code reachable from the initial configuration code by finitely many one-step transitions
is not accepting.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Acceptance from a reachable accepting code]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.mem_of_exists_acc}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.mem_of_exists_acc}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.mem_initLang, Complexity.Codec.mem_of_codePath, Complexity.ExpBFS.RCode, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.AccM, Turing.FinNDTM.DecidesInSpace}
\difficulty{3}
Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine deciding a language $L$ in
space $sp$, and let $x$ be a bit string. If some natural number $t$ is reachable from
the initial configuration code by zero or more valid steps within a fixed work-tape
window and encodes an accepting configuration in that window, then $x\in L$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Language membership from stable reachability counts]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.mem_iff_exists_acc_of_card_eq}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.mem_iff_exists_acc_of_card_eq}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.mem_acceptLang, Complexity.ExpBFS.RCode, Complexity.ExpBFS.WinRun, Complexity.ExpBFS.WinRun.last, Complexity.ExpBFS.WinRun.mono, Complexity.ExpBFS.rcode_iff, Complexity.ExpBFS.rset, Complexity.ExpBFS.winRun_of_card_eq, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.AccM, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.mem_of_exists_acc, Turing.FinNDTM.DecidesInSpace}
\difficulty{4}
Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine deciding a language $L$ in
space $sp$, and let $x$ be a bit string. For any natural number $s$ with $1\le s$, if
the finite sets of configuration codes reachable from the initial configuration within
the $s-1$ and $s$ work-tape windows have equal cardinality, then $x\in L$ if and only if
some code reachable from the initial configuration by zero or more valid $s$-window
steps encodes an accepting configuration.
\end{theorem}
